gloss: to soak; to immerse; to dip

definitions.gloss: to soak; to immerse; to steep
definitions.explanation: To place something in liquid so that it absorbs the liquid or becomes saturated.
To briefly put something into liquid, typically for eating or coating.

examples.japanese: {乾燥|かんそう}わかめを{水|みず}に{浸|ひた}す。
examples.english: Soak the dried wakame in water.

examples.japanese: {足|あし}を{温|あたた}かいお{湯|ゆ}に{浸|ひた}す。
examples.english: Soak your feet in warm water.

examples.japanese: {豆|まめ}を{一晩|ひとばん}{水|みず}に{浸|ひた}しておく。
examples.english: Leave the beans soaking in water overnight.

examples.japanese: パンを{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}に{浸|ひた}して{食|た}べる。
examples.english: Dip the bread in milk and eat it.

examples.japanese: {天|てん}ぷらを{塩|しお}に{浸|ひた}す。
フライドポテトをケチャップに{浸|ひた}して{食|た}べるのが{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: I like dipping french fries in ketchup and eating them.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
{他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
Pair: {浸|ひた}る (intransitive - to be soaked)
Pattern: XをYに{浸|ひた}す

ASPECT (ている):
{浸|ひた}している indicates ongoing action or resulting state (something is being/remaining soaked).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{水|みず}に{浸|ひた}す - to soak in water
・お{湯|ゆ}に{浸|ひた}す - to soak in hot water
・{出汁|だし}に{浸|ひた}す - to soak in broth

COOKING USAGE:
Used for rehydrating dried ingredients ({乾物|かんぶつ}), marinating, or preparing ingredients before cooking.

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
・{浸|ひた}し{物|もの} / お{浸|ひた}し - boiled greens soaked in dashi
・{水|みず}に{浸|ひた}しておく - to leave soaking in water
